newsitem.title: USA: UTI agrees to acquire 8 drilling rigs.
newsitem.headline: UTI agrees to acquire 8 drilling rigs.

text.p: UTI Energy Corp said Wednesday directors approved the acquisition of the contract drilling operations of Southland Drilling Co Ltd of Houston for $15 million in cash and issue a $13 million promissory note and 100,000 five-year warrants at an exercise price of $48 per share.

UTI said it is purchasing eight drilling rigs and an office building and fabrication shop located on 20 acres in Victoria, Texas. This acquisition establishes a base for UTI's growing operations in the South Texas/Gulf Coast areas.

UTI said the purchase price may be reduced by $750,000 should UTI elect to pay cash in lieu of issuing the promissory note. The acquisition is subject to the arrangement of financing acceptable to UTI, it added.
If the transaction is not closed due to the financing condition, Southland will be entitled to retain a $500,000 deposit and receive an additional $500,000 termination fee.
